summary: Oneida County, WI tower beside Highway 45 near Margaret Lake; a 1949 report describes a platform with a cab planned. Listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: A May 1949 report said the tower had only a platform and that a cab would be built so a fire-watcher could work there full time

evidence.supports: tower beside Highway 45 near Margaret Lake
evidence.quote: It was reported that a cab will be constructed atop the Piehl tower located next to Highway 45 near Margaret Lake.

evidence.supports: tower then had only a platform
evidence.quote: At present the tower is equipped only with a platform.

evidence.supports: cab would let a fire-watcher stay on full-time duty
evidence.quote: The cab will permit a fire-watcher to remain on full-time duty at the tower.

evidence.supports: item attributed to the Rhinelander Daily News

notes_for_editor: The 1949 item describes a platform with a cab planned, not a finished cab, and gives no construction date. It is quoted secondhand: the Central US Lookouts page prints the Rhinelander Daily News attribution, but the newspaper itself was not checked. Brief's county, coordinates and gone status check out against the FFLA list and OSM. No new photos found.
